_doc: Operational regression alarm on the mass the pipeline invents rather than observes, enforced by _check_fill_mass_against_baseline in src/crimerisk/trend_fills.py (the two agency-estimate metrics) and check_benchmark_mass_against_baseline in src/crimerisk/benchmark_imputation.py (benchmark_imputed_mass). NOT a validity claim about any individual estimate: it is a tripwire that fails the build when the amount of crime mass the pipeline invents, or the number of agencies it invents it for, jumps. Only increases beyond tolerance fail; the intended direction of travel is down. Accepting a genuine increase means editing these numbers deliberately with a rationale in docs/STATE.md, the same contract scripts/diagnostics/methodology_baseline.json uses -- never to silence a failure.
seeded_from: 2024 agency target estimates rebuilt 2026-07-29 after the Stage 1 fix batch (cross-lane twin identity resolution, ORI succession, NIBRS completion re-keyed on the batch header, coherent partial-year semantics on every lane, the fill recency bound, per-agency-year lane selection, production-scope exclusion at Stage 1). The metric fell because the pipeline now invents far less: 155,789 counts of own-history fill on 1,935 agencies whose last usable report predates the recency bound are gone, 32,068 counts of resurrected superseded ORIs are gone, and 13,829 rows of what used to be a hist_median or trend fill are now the agency's own partial-year report annualised (true_partial_month_ratio, a lane-grounded source). Prior values for reference: v19 non_observed_estimate_mass 433936.3 / filled_agency_count 3904; v18 546970.1 / 6654.
benchmark_imputed_mass_seeded_from: 2024 v20 Class A benchmark-constrained imputation, first build 2026-07-28: 9,181.1 counts over 306 silent territory units (95 county remainder cells + 211 municipal jurisdictions). This metric is a DIFFERENT quantity from the two above -- it is jurisdiction-target mass sized against the FBI CDE state estimate for territory no agency reported, never an agency-level estimate -- and it shares the tolerance only because it shares the contract.
benchmark_imputed_mass_expected_to_move: NOT YET RE-SEEDED. The Stage 1 fix batch moves territory OUT of the agency fill lane and INTO this one by design (the fill recency bound routes rostered non-reporters to benchmark imputation), so the first full surface build after the batch is expected to breach this figure. It is left at the v20 value deliberately: the breach is the tripwire doing its job and must be re-seeded from a measured build, not pre-emptively loosened here. Measuring it requires jurisdiction controls, which this batch did not build.
benchmark_reseed_note: Re-seeded 2026-07-30 from the measured Stage-3 consumption-restructure build (was 9181.1): municipal fills no longer lock controls, so benchmark imputation now reaches the territory it was designed for (silent municipal population 281,778 -> 3,671,138; units 306 -> 953). Deliberate, supervisor-adjudicated; rationale in docs/STATE.md Stage 3 close record. The tripwire fired as designed before this re-seed.
adjudication_reseed_note: Re-seeded 2026-07-30 after Stage-1 adjudication registries wired into the build: 446 adjudicated agency-years reject published values that are not measured years (misread zeros -> missing; token years -> not usable), moving those agencies to honest fills/imputation. Before-run reproduced the prior baseline (253,553.56/2,815), so the movement is fully attributable and in the designed direction. Rationale in docs/STATE.md Stage 1 consumption record.
